meta.name: triage
meta.description: Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles — categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分类和验证 issue 与 PR，生成 agent 可读的简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化管理 GitHub 上的 issue 和外部 PR 流程
copy.tagline_en: Automatically categorize and verify issues and PRs, generate agent-ready briefs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate the management of GitHub issues and external PRs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你对 GitHub Issue 和外部 PR 进行分类、验证、追问，并生成供 AI 或人类处理的摘要。
howto.when: 当你在项目仓库中执行 `/triage` 命令并描述需求时触发，例如查看待处理项或处理特定 Issue/PR。

say.text: 帮我看看有哪些 Issue 需要处理。
say.note: Claude 会列出未分类、待评估等状态的 Issue。
Claude 会直接应用状态并询问是否需要写摘要。
Claude 会分析 PR 并给出分类和状态建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can classify, verify, grill, and write agent-ready briefs for GitHub issues and external PRs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you run `/triage` in the project repository and describe what you want, e.g., to see pending items or handle a specific issue/PR.

say_en.text: Show me what issues need attention.
say_en.note: Claude lists unlabeled, needs-triage, and needs-info items.
Claude applies the state directly and asks if you want a brief.
Claude analyzes the PR and recommends category and state.
